macros.name: svnInfoDate
macros.doc: The date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, when the file was checked out.

macros.name: svnInfoFile
macros.doc: The name of the source file.

macros.name: svnInfoLongDate
macros.doc: The date in the form of \today when the file was checked out.

macros.name: svnInfoMaxRevision
macros.doc: The maximum revision number of multi-file documents.

macros.name: svnInfoMaxToday
macros.doc: The date obtained from the latest Subversion revision in the format \today is using.

macros.name: svnInfoMinRevision
macros.doc: The minimum revision number of multi-file documents.

macros.name: svnInfoOwner
macros.doc: The user name of the file owner.

macros.name: svnInfoTime
macros.doc: The time, when the file was checked out.

macros.name: svnToday
macros.doc: The date obtained from the Subversion information in the format \today is using.
